summary: Focused iteration-7 retest completed on public preview for autoplay regression, celebrity shared-hook behavior, CMS marker/image safety, WebGL motion proof, and enquiry/auth backend sanity. BeadJourney fix is validated; one residual issue remains in Celebrity hover-pause behavior.

ui_bugs.issue: Autoplay does not pause on pointer hover. Repro: select Milind -> click Play stories -> keep cursor over .patron-carousel for 6.2s -> story still advances to Dimple.

action_items: Fix shared useVisibleSequence hover pause behavior for Celebrity section so pointer hover reliably blocks autoplay ticks.
Re-run only celebrity autoplay matrix after fix: hover/focus/manual/play/reduced-motion.
Keep restored baseline page-content (bead[1] locations empty) as current canonical state.
critical_code_review_comments: BeadJourney autoplay fix works as intended after manual select + focused Play click.
Shared hook is still not behaving consistently in Celebrity hover scenario; likely event-state/timer interaction in carousel host.
ContentField beads-image change correctly invalidates previous marker verification flags before publish (no stale verified marker rendered publicly).
seed_data_creation: Created temporary QA verified bead marker in admin mapping workflow; published, validated publicly, then restored full baseline revision. Created 2 QA_TEST Iter7 leads (inline/popup) in backend test and deleted both.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated BeadJourney matrix: auto-advance visible, manual-select pause + Play resume while button retains focus, pause stop, prev wrap, ArrowUp/ArrowDown keyboard, offscreen/doc-hidden pause, reduced-motion no-auto, and no page jump during rail auto-centering. Celebrity checks: autoplay timing Milind->Dimple->Sunanda at ~5.5s intervals, manual tab then Play resumes, focus pause works, reduced-motion no-auto works, desktop left/right alternation works, mobile 390 stacked readable with no portrait/editorial overlap, all 3 photos+story texts present, Sunanda source points to Rudralife domain and has no personal quote block, hidden focusable control count is 0. Residual bug: hover pause fails consistently in Celebrity section.
rca of the issue: Celebrity hover-pause bug reproduced in 3 runs. Most deterministic repro: open /siddha-mala.html -> scroll to celebrity -> click patron-select-milind -> click patron-autoplay (Play stories) -> keep pointer inside .patron-carousel for >6s. Expected: active panel unchanged while hovered. Actual: patron-milind advances to patron-dimple. Likely root cause is shared sequence timer continuing despite hover state in this section (event-state/timer synchronization issue).
